zh-Hans: 在文件动态里按格式跨目录浏览，STEP 模型合并显示 .step 和 .stp 文件
主窗口、快捷窗口和设置页换上纸面外观，关于页的纸箱可以点开
目录暂时无法读取时，文件动态会在后台重试，并提示需要重新授权的目录
en: Browse recent activity by format across folders, with .step and .stp files grouped as STEP models
The main window, quick window and Settings have a paper-inspired look. Click the box in About for a surprise
Recent activity retries temporarily unavailable folders and flags folders that need access again
